title: Rory and the Silver Cedar Dell
verses:
The sun drifted down past the edge of the hill,
As evening was painting the valley in blue,
The wind in the branches was steady and still,
And Rory was brushing through ribbons of dew.

Beside him walked Tilly along through the glade,
While Benny leaned down with a welcoming sigh,
They rested their feet in the cedar-tree shade,
Beneath the vast quilt of the darkening sky.

Then Ricky was ready to finish his play,
As Psittaco settled to cozy his nest,
The last golden ribbons were fading away,
To whisper that all of the valley should rest.

Above them swooped Nia on wings wide and slow,
She drifted right down through the cool evening air,
To watch the dim river of starlight below,
And settle beside them without any care.

Now Rory curled down on a carpet of green,
And offered a yawn as the shadows grew deep,
The woods were the calmest that ever were seen,
Preparing the friends for an evening of sleep.

The silver moon shone with a comforting glow,
And sleepy stars watched as the night settled in,
The breathing of Rory grew gentle and slow,
Where sweet slumbering journeys were set to begin.
